commonSamples.scope: Actual nearest saved samples with explicit time offsets; no interpolation. Added breakpoints can change solver trajectory. These selected times do not substitute for the full-window gate.

voltageGate.boundary: The strict all-saved/nonincreasing result is preserved. The separate board budget excludes only the two behavioral DAC control voltages; it is not full-repeat or physical qualification.

scope: Full reset-release window with fixed circuit, Newton tolerances, runtime and retained sampling grids. Explicit trtol=1 must reproduce the implicit XSPICE baseline; the candidate changes only trtol to 0.25. Compare both successive timestep refinements over the full window without alignment or omitted peaks. Full-repeat, coupled rollback and physical admission remain separate.
